counts.count_scope: 21 subordinate planning identities (10 source-present + 11 draft/proposed), 1 umbrella; 3 non-OS roles. Proposed Progress OS is not a live worker.

rules: This is a proposed normalized roster, not a census of every branded module across all AoE2WAR repositories.
OS classification requires unique owner, authority, executable contract, evidence, recovery and measured value.
Do not count Doctor or Shepherd as OSs. Do not count umbrella as its own subordinate OS.
Public system-agent cards are source projections; unknown worker activity is not running.
New systems reuse existing code, storage and receipts; no deletion/replacement just to rename.
Website deployment P0 never waits for this P3 registry. Wolo financial authority remains separate.
Code Health has distinct existing source contract; add it to planning roster without claiming separate daemon
Performance is an alias of Speed, Renaissance integration facet, Council composite diagnostic, Loop and Graph engines are cross-cutting rather than OS
22 named planning identities including umbrella; verified live estate remains UNKNOWN; never present planning count as certified operational count
System Composer is a proposed Orchestra OS role; never a subordinate OS or autonomous production authority.
Seven visual modes share one evidence projection. Never promote simulation/polling/animation to observed live telemetry.
P3 visual and composition planning cannot block F #1083 P0 website #1061 or alter Deployment OS #1088.

truth_rules: visual animation is not a worker heartbeat
source and host do not imply public live
unreviewed graph is simulation not dispatch
no cyclic blocking edges or duplicate write leases

lifecycle_extension_proposal.boundary: Proposed logical identities only. Central prioritizes, Orchestra leases, original domain controllers execute. Renaissance remains integration facet. Reuse existing composer graph/provenance; no new scheduler, daemon, authority or release prerequisite.

truth_rules: gross allocation is not net reclaimed bytes
source coverage is not independent restore or retirement
public projection excludes private paths and secrets
no execution authority or additional release gate

rules: Parent slot is founder catalog hierarchy, owner slot is proposed existing authority routing; neither grants permission. Null canonical ID means distinct registration not approved.
Commands are catalog references, not permission or automatic invocation. Follow source owner scope and existing approvals.
Organization source links remain canonical for object records. Phonebook indexes this existing registry, no second datastore.
Intelligence is deterministic operational collection and recommendations; Kingdom Brain is read-only visual authority/dependency atlas.
No secrets, new services, release gate or self-certified live proof. All unverified runtime states stay UNKNOWN.
